allow: PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe", "$env:ProgramFiles\\Docker\\Docker\\Docker Desktop.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $p" } else { Write-Output "MISSING: $p" } }; Write-Output "--- ollama ---"; if \(Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { ollama --version } else { Write-Output "ollama not on PATH" }; Write-Output "--- ollama api ---"; try { \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/tags" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3\).Content } catch { Write-Output "ollama API not responding: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
